children: Australian stocks are set to begin trading a tad lower, with ASX futures down by 0.1% ahead of Tuesday's open. The S&P/ASX 200 has been lacking direction with U.S. investors on break for Labor Day. The benchmark index closed 0.1% higher Monday. Shares including BlueScope Steel, Mineral Resources, News Corp and Regis Healthcare will trade ex-dividend. After Monday's close, Santos said it has agreed to buy an additional 3.3% interest in Papua LNG from TotalEnergies. (rhiannon.hoyle@wsj.com; @RhiannonHoyle)
